prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Professional orthographic character modeling reference sheet, exactly TWO full-body views of the SAME character beside one another: FRONT on left and RIGHT SIDE PROFILE facing LEFT on right. Same height, same floor baseline, absolutely orthographic, no perspective, no three-quarter view. No typography, no divider, no decorative layout, no cast shadows. Pure white background.

Subject: Amberwatch human male knight, high quality hand-painted fantasy MMORPG game character, heroic stocky powerful proportions, about six heads tall. Handsome stern mature face, broad jaw, short swept-back chestnut brown hair, close trimmed brown beard, clearly visible expressive face without helmet. Very broad layered dark teal and desaturated steel-blue pauldrons with thick warm brass borders, fitted teal breastplate with a bold central golden diamond crest, sculpted breastplate volume, warm brass belt buckle, brown leather waist belt and gloves, steel-blue articulated thigh armor and knee plates, substantial steel-blue armored boots with golden trim. Short teal tabard hanging between legs from waist to mid thigh, no cape. Palette teal, warm aged gold, muted steel blue, rich brown leather. Beautiful painterly crafted highlights and material definition, broad readable shapes, restrained engraved detail. AAA stylized game concept presentation.

Pose: neutral relaxed A-pose, arms angled only 18 degrees outward from vertical, both hands completely visible and separate from torso, fingers together naturally, legs straight with a clear gap between legs, feet pointing straight forward. Side view shows exactly the same pose, arm resting slightly behind torso center so chest profile can be read. Anatomically consistent matching head height, shoulder level, waist, knees and feet across views. Full silhouette including hair and boot soles with 6 percent white margin on all sides. Front character centered at 30 percent canvas width, side centered at 75 percent width. Face should be exceptionally clear, frontal eyes looking straight ahead in front view. Soft neutral studio illumination, no harsh directional shadows, no weapon, no shield, no floating accessories, no environment. Image is a production reference and a source for projection painting onto a 3D mesh: clear contour and faithful front/profile consistency are paramount.
